24 encoder blocks

T5-XXL text encoder

Official loading uses T5EncoderModel: only the encoder, with no T5 decoder.

Text token embedding[B,L,4096]Vocabulary 32128; schnell text is typically truncated/padded to 128 tokens
↓
24 × RMSNorm → bidirectional attention → residual[B,L,4096]64 heads ×64 dimensions; Q/K/V/O each W[4096,4096], no bias
↓
Per-layer RMSNorm → gated GELU FFN → residual[B,L,4096]Two 4096→10240 branches; apply GELU to one, multiply by the other, then project 10240→4096
↓
Final RMSNorm[B,L,4096]Output per-token features to txt_in
  • Only the first layer owns relative_attention_bias [32,64]; positional bias is reused in later layers.
  • LayerNorm is scale-only T5 RMSNorm, without beta; no learned absolute positional embedding is added.

Image latent and conditioning projections

Image latents, per-token text, timesteps and CLIP vectors enter the same 3072-dimensional space.

Inputs from

latent pack 2×2[B,N,64]16-channel latent [B,16,H/8,W/8] → N=H·W/256; pack four positions into 64 dimensions, assuming H/W are multiples of 16
↓
img_in / txt_in[B,N,3072] / [B,L,3072]Image 64→3072; T5 text 4096→3072
↓
timestep sinusoid → time_in[B,3072]Parameter-free 256-dimensional sin/cos; MLP 256→3072→3072, SiLU
↓
CLIP vector → vector_in; add the timestep vector[B,3072]MLP 768→3072→3072，SiLU
↓
Position IDs → 3-axis RoPE128 dimensions per headaxes_dim=[16,56,56], no learned parameters
  • FLUX.1-schnell has guidance_embed=False; it has no guidance_in MLP from the dev variant.
  • Noise, timesteps, RoPE and sampler state are excluded. The same denoiser is reused over sampling steps; parameters must not be multiplied by step count.

Double-stream Transformer

Image and text have separate projections/MLPs, but their QKV sequences are concatenated for joint attention.

Inputs from

Separate AdaLN modulation for image and text[B,N,3072] and [B,L,3072]Each stream: condition→SiLU→Linear 3072→18432, split into two shift/scale/gate triplets
↓
Per-stream QKV → Q/K RMSNorm → RoPE[B,24,N or L,128]Per-stream QKV W[9216,3072]; two RMSNorms each γ[128], shared across 24 heads
↓
Concatenate along sequence; joint non-causal attention[B,24,L+N,L+N]Split back into text and image segments after attention
↓
Per-stream attention output projection + gated residual[B,N or L,3072]Each W[3072,3072]
↓
Per-stream second AdaLN → MLP → gated residual[B,N or L,3072]3072→12288→3072, GELU(tanh), with bias
  • Base LayerNorm has elementwise_affine=False, so no separate γ/β is counted. AdaLN modulation Linear weights are counted.
  • ×38 below means 19 layers × 2 independent image/text branches, not shared weights.

VAE decoder → RGB image

Invert latent normalization, then upsample 8× through convolutions, residual blocks and attention.

Inputs from

Invert latent scaling and shifting[B,16,H/8,W/8]z / 0.3611 + 0.1159
↓
Conv3×3 16→512 → middle[B,512,H/8,W/8]ResBlock512→512, single-head spatial attention, ResBlock512→512
↓
4 up stages, each with 3 ResBlocksChannels 512→512→256→128Levels 3 to 0; first three stages end with nearest-neighbor 2× upsampling then Conv3×3
↓
GroupNorm → SiLU → Conv3×3 128→3[B,3,H,W]RGB output; all GroupNorms use groups=32 with γ/β
  • ResBlock: GN(in)→SiLU→Conv3×3(in→out)→GN(out)→SiLU→Conv3×3(out→out), plus skip; use Conv1×1 on the skip when in≠out.
  • Middle attention: GN512; Q/K/V/proj each Conv1×1(512→512) with bias; no RoPE.
